goal: Move ready buyers to EllieMD immediately while retaining a CoreAxis relationship for future support and curated offers.

stages.action: Acknowledge interest and ask one short routing question only when needed.

stages.condition: User asks for link, price, how to start, availability, or states they are ready.
stages.action: Send EllieMD link immediately. Do not force education or a funnel before the purchase path.

stages.condition: User asks what it is, who it is for, or which option may fit.
stages.action: Answer briefly using approved campaign materials, then offer the EllieMD link.

stages.condition: Link has been sent or user is not purchasing immediately.
stages.action: Invite the user to remain connected to CoreAxis for curated education, wellness guidance, and future offers without delaying the EllieMD link.
Record close and revenue; retain the relationship only with permission.

guardrails: Do not diagnose or promise outcomes.
Do not imply eligibility before provider review.
Do not block a ready buyer with a questionnaire or long educational sequence.
Do not mix EllieMD records with another campaign lane.
Do not send repeated follow-ups after opt-out or disinterest.
